intro.text: SideChannel is a cybersecurity advisory services and software company. Our mission is to make cybersecurity simple and accessible for mid-market and emerging companies, a market that we believe is currently underserved. Our solutions provide effective cybersecurity risk management for our clients. We anticipate that our target customers will continue to need cost-effective security solutions. We continue to expand our catalogue of services and solutions to address the cybersecurity needs of our customers, including virtual Chief Information Security Officer (“vCISO”), cyber program strategy, zero trust, third-party risk management, compliance readiness, cloud security and architecture services, privacy, threat intelligence, managed end-point security solutions, and awareness and training.

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Short-term investments
lines.why: Securities held for the cash they will return: financial.

lines.name: Receivables
lines.why: Owed by customers for sales: operating.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Deferred revenue
lines.why: Customers' payments ahead of delivery: operating.

lines.name: Long-term debt (incl. current portion)
lines.why: Bonds, notes and loans, current maturities included: financial.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Other assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total assets minus the lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total liabilities minus the lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

Our ability to continue as a going concern may depend upon our ability to raise additional capital and such capital may not be available on acceptable terms, or at all.

The amount of capital we may need depends on many factors, including the progress, timing, scope and market acceptance of our product development programs; the time and cost required to obtain any necessary regulatory approvals; the possibility of litigation; our ability to enter into and maintain collaborative, licensing and other commercial relationships; and our ability to secure commitment of time and resources from third parties to the development and commercialization of our products.
The amount of capital that we may be able to raise depends on variables that are beyond our control.
The extent of such dilution will depend on the number of shares issued.
We rely on third-party software for certain essential financial and operational services.
Failure, outages or disruption in services, systems and infrastructure supplied by third parties could negatively affect our business, financial condition and financial results.
We depend on our direct sales force to obtain new customers or retain and increase sales with existing customers.
Our consulting services represent a significant source of revenue, and our success depends on attracting, developing, and retaining highly qualified professionals.
Our success depends on accurately anticipating these developments, aligning our solutions with market needs, and managing timely product launches and transitions.
Our ability to maintain growth and competitiveness depends on timely product development and continual innovation.
Our success depends on the market’s confidence in our ability to provide effective network security protection.

Expanding internationally and selling outside the United States may depend on our ability to comply with evolving export control laws and government-imposed restrictions on the sale or use of cybersecurity products.
Our primary source of liquidity and capital resources was the $1.3 million of cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments at the beginning of fiscal year 2025.
